profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

positions.title: Simulation-Model Research Assistant- Data Visualization Lab
positions.description:
Constructed a mathematical model to simulate density of runners in the Chicago Marathon with real time updates

Analyzed Chicago Marathon runner’s data for the years 2009-2016 using statistical software to find relevant variables to use in runner-tracker model

Researched and implemented methodology for creating a more agile and robust model to simulate runners during the
marathon

Finalist in the INFORMS Analytics prize competition

positions.title: Production Assistant
positions.description:
Assisted and lead the production of 10 concerts ensuring an optimal performance setting for the headlining artists

Managed operations for the venue including ticket sales, security, and complaints to successfully quelling potentially
volatile situations

positions.title: Business Intern
positions.description:
Managed marketing communications of the company’s ecommerce store consisting of about 90 new, used and refurbished electronics and over 400 email subscribers.

Developed and implemented online advertisements and email marketing campaigns to promote products in a more user- friendly and aesthetically pleasing manner; resulting in a 22% increase in sales in a two-month time period

 Increased web traffic being of e-commerce store by initiating a more aggressive email advertising campaign resulting in 50 new email subscribers
